title: Get the first, middle and last item of a list
description:
Get the first item, the middle item and the last item of the list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as first_middle_last(lst), where lst has an odd number of items, returning a tuple (first_item, middle_item, last_item).
hints: The first item is at index 0 and the last item is at index -1.
For an odd-length list, integer division of the length by 2 gives the middle index.
expected_behavior: Returns a 3-tuple of (first, middle, last) items from lst.
explanation: Indexing with 0 and -1 reaches the ends of the list, and len(lst) // 2 lands exactly on the middle element when the list has an odd length.
